Chain-square zero checked on every generator; 9 generating transpositions checked for equivariance; all 144 automorphism traces equal independent orbit-series traces; 15 irreducible inner products give claimed decomposition. Checker is standalone and fully embedded.

value.rationale: K3,4 is the next natural asymmetric complete-bipartite graph beyond K3,3, with much richer S3×S4 automorphism representation. Its 28-dimensional H2 decomposition determines all 15 character values, seven distinct Specht-product types, multiplicities, and vanishing invariants. Those natural symmetry invariants are not implied by ordinary Betti dimensions or smaller-graph results and benchmark broader equivariant graph-braid techniques.
